prerequisites: Structure of atom, fundamentals of crystallography
Basic concepts in physical chemistry (entropy, free energy, free enthalpy, phases, phase equilibria, chemical equilibria)
Structure of real crystals (crystal lattice defects and their properties)
Phases in metallic and ceramic systems. Equilibrium diagrams
Deformation and fracture properties, testing of mechanical properties of structural materials

learning_outcomes.text: Provide knowledge on the composition, structure, and treatment of materials in relation to their properties that are relevant for treatment technologies and design applications.
Enable understanding the essence of the above processes and their mutual causal relations.
Provide technologists with the knowledge of the relations between the structure, sub-structure, and treatment properties of structural materials.
Teach designers how to make full use of structural materials.
Define the principles for technically and economically suitable application for all materials (of both current and enhanced properties).

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of the metallurgy of iron and steel
Accompanying and additive elements in alloys of iron and carbon
Phase transformation in the heat treatment of ferrous alloys
Low-carbon structural steels for welded structures, case-hardening steel, deep drawing steel, structural steels for heat treatment
Steels resistant to corrosion, heat, creep
Non-ferrous metals and alloys I \u2013 Al, Mg, Ti
Structural metals and alloys II \u2013 Cu, Ni, Co
Introductory exercises. Organizational matters, training, work safety
Standard marking the steels and cast irons
Structure and properties of iron alloys.
Austenitizace, diagrams. of the IRA, ARA
Non-ferrous metals I-solders and Al alloys

assessment_methods.method: Participation in practices and submitted reports

assessment_rules: The examination consists of written and oral parts. In the written part, students answer four questions related to topics dealt with in the course. In the oral part, students answer questions from the written part and additional questions from the examiner. Participation in practices is mandatory; absences must be properly excused. Unit credit is conditional on participating in all exercises and completing reports according to instructions. Missed exercises require an extra assignment in the form of a written report.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
